_readme: THE BOARD (owner ruling 2026-11-17, docs/projects/active/ONE_BOARD_PLAN.md): the ONLY place a project's status is written.
Other trackers (TODO, plan headers, the roadmap, memory, index pages) point here and never restate it. Change a project's line
in the same commit as the work that changes it. Activity, walks owed and production state are derived by scripts/owner-brief.mjs.
goals    = ids from the goals list. A project whose goals are all 'after' goals sits in the After launch lane.
lane     = now | next | later. Now holds at most three, in the owner's order (order = 1, 2, 3); the owner sets it.
phase    = Planning | Drawing | Asks to rule | Building | Walk owed | Ready to release | Live | Parked. Live = done.
stage    = 'Now: … → Next: …' in words. next = the single next action. remains = what is left, one or two sentences.
waitsOn  = projects that must be done before the NEXT step can start (a Now project may have none open).
finishesAfter = projects that must be done before this one can FINISH (sequencing only).
youOwe   = steps only the owner can take (rulings, dashboard steps, approvals). Never walks: those come from the ledger.
checked  = false until the project's line has been truth-checked against its plan body, the ledger and git.
files    = plan-file basenames whose history is the project's activity. ledger = words in its QA ledger section titles.
state    = open | parked | closed. Parked needs parked: { since, reason } in the owner's words. Only the owner parks or closes.
Words on the board are product-owner English: no file paths, hashes or internal codes beyond a § walk number.

goals.name: Canadian launch
goals.doneWhen: Done when a Canadian club signs up, pays us on Stripe, connects its own Stripe so families pay online, and opens a house league or a tournament, run once from start to finish with you watching.

goals.name: The board pack can be shown
goals.doneWhen: Done when the security and privacy brief, diagrams, questionnaire and Security page are ready; the terms, privacy policy, data terms and supplier list are published; backups are written down and a restore rehearsed; and the public roadmap is signed off.

goals.name: Ongoing quality
goals.doneWhen: Never finished: release safety, walks owed and the product's housekeeping live here.

goals.name: After the Canadian launch
goals.doneWhen: Picked up once the Canadian launch is done: marketing, the demo, and product work the launch does not need.

goals.name: US launch
goals.doneWhen: Done when US clubs can buy every plan in US dollars and take online payments. Starts after the Canadian launch.

projects.remains: Built. Owed: the full payout test, the payments terms (not started), live payouts set up in Stripe, the tax on our fee (from the GST/HST project) and your switch-on.
youOwe: Set up live payouts to clubs in Stripe (platform settings and the two live notifications)
Approve the payments terms once /legal drafts them
Turn online payments on, once the terms exist

projects.name: Stripe clean-up, and Stripe from our admin

projects.next: Run the read-only comparison of the test and live Stripe accounts and write you the keep, archive and fix list.
projects.remains: The clean-up and one live purchase, cancel and refund before Club goes on sale. The later stages (one-customer tools, price changes, our own invoices) are after launch.
youOwe: Make the Stripe dashboard changes on the clean-up list (it starts with ten missing live notifications)
Press the billing portal once in live so our portal settings exist there
Run the live purchase, cancel and refund (about a dollar)

projects.name: Club release

Then release readiness: a Club test suite, the layout check on staging, the help re-read, the support plan and the plan for undoing a bad release, the database changes moved to production, turning Club on for sale, and the start-to-finish run-through with you watching.
